column5: Cropin is a multi-country ag-ecosystem intelligence provider, supporting agriculture through a suite of products powered by artificial intelligence, machine learning, and remote sensing. Across 56 countries and through multiple partnerships, Cropin digitizes operations reaching million acres of farmland and nearly 7 million farmers. Its agnostic solutions include geotagging, crop detection, input monitoring, weather advisories, and remote crop health monitoring. The platform aims for for extensive farm digitization, improved data accuracy, traceability, and increased productivity, contributing to sustainable and profitable agriculture.

column5: A leading agri-tech in Pakistan, BaKhabar Kissan (BKK) takes a holistic approach to enable farmers make data driven decisions. They cater both production and market/sales related issues that exist in the Agri value chain. BKK not only provide crop, livestock, weather, mandi rates, remote sensing based advisory to farmers, but also connect them to consumers and business. Every farmer has his/her own journey on BKK, based on their profile (location/crop etc.). It's available in 7 languages and through it's web portal, 24/7 call center/SMS/IVR and mobile apps providing major services such as Weather Advisory; Livestock Advisory; Advisory Modern Technologies; Disaster Management; Content (Written, Audio, Video); Advisory Inputs / Machinery; Agri Commerce; and Market/Mandi Rates and price analytics.

column5: SatSure Sparta is an open innovation data platform that enables the combination of satellite imagery with weather, IoT, social and economic datasets, among others, to generate timely, location-specific and actionable insights that can be used by agritech companies, agrifood corporates and financial services firms. Capability and features: Agribusinesses can use SatSure Sparta to access satellite data products as APIs to build and scale agricultural advisory and farm management solutions. By using SatSure Sparta, clients do not need to invest in building remote sensing teams and can scale their businesses faster by easily integrating spatial intelligence into their operations and offering satellite-derived predictive insights as a value-add to their customers. In the Philippines, SatSure, in partnership with the Philippines Department of Agriculture and a crop insurance company, has worked with about 90,000 farmers to provide improved yield assessments, post-typhoon damage assessments and targeted extension services.

column5: SmartFarm Korea is building an optimum growing environment for crops through open and integrated data platform for smart farming. It collects, analyze and process smart farm operation datasets, and provide integrated, comprehensive and open access to information on smart farming. SMARTFARM KOREA provides a library of greenhouse horticultural crop and livestock farming datasets through a service called Smartfarm Datamart. Currently this database contains data covering seven greenhouse horticultural crops (tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, strawberries, sweet peppers, cucumbers, eggplants and oriental melons) and livestock production (of beef cattle, dairy cattle, pigs and poultry). The datasets of Smartfarm Datamart comprise field data collected since 2016. SMARTFARM KOREA offers a self-assessment tool for livestock farmers seeking to boost their productivity and sales through advanced technologies and data-driven farm operations. Farmers can gauge their farms digital readiness for the use of a big data analytics platform by entering details about their farms concerning for example the livestock species they raise, their breeding environments, the diseases/insects they are exposed to, and their farm operations.

column5: Gokomodo is a leading Indonesian agritech supply chain company. Gokomodo is a B2B company for agribusiness supply chain and services in Indonesia that aims to provide easy access to high-quality products at competitive prices through procurement, e-commerce, and distribution platforms. Gokmodo aims to create easy and equal access to good quality, competitively priced agri-inputs for stakeholders in the Indonesian agribusiness sector, from smallholders to corporates, through its integrated physical and digital infrastructure. Gokomodo is currently present in 7 provinces. The company works with leading agribusinesses, Village Cooperatives (KUD) and retail farming shops (Toko Tani) to distribute agri-inputs and ultimately empower smallholders, towards supporting national agriculture productivity.

Developed by mPower Social Enterprise Ltd in partnership with Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) and CARE Bangladesh adn funded by USAID, the Crop Diagnostics Application is a smartphone based tool that helps farmers diagnose any problem in a crop especially pest and disease infliction. Once a farmer identifies the specific problem, the app then suggests associated curative measures for that problem. The solution has two main features 1) IMAGE BASED DIAGNOSTIC TOOL: The app contains information with real images about various diseases that can occur at different parts of the crop and 2) OFFLINE ACESSIBILITY: The app functions without internet. The Crop Diagnostics Application enables farmers easily diagnose any disease or pest attack by matching the photos in app and it also gives instant curative advice to farmer for that specific pest or disease attack. 

The solution has so far reached 55,000+ farmers across Bangladesh and the number of services provided are more than 20,500. It has had significant impact on farmers lives and 95% farmers who used the app reported that the App is a credible diagnostic tool while 98% of the farmers reported they believed the App as an information source (Source: Evaluation of ICT Component of the Agricultural Extension Support Activity; I-CHASS, University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign)
